team.name: Example Team (fictional)
agreements: We decide by consensus. If we can't in 3 minutes, we vote using the matrix criteria.
Nobody stars a finding whose source nobody has opened.
Carla keeps time; anyone can call 'decide now'.

agenda.label: Sprint 1 · PESTEL research (each person one dimension)
Sprint 1 · Share and pick the key factors
Sprint 2 · How the sector works (each person one dimension)
Define the chosen idea + launch market

criteria.label: Evidence the problem is real
criteria.hint: Data, sources, reviews, reports. Not opinions.

criteria.label: Clear, reachable customer
criteria.hint: Can you name them and find 10 of them next week?

criteria.label: Size of the opportunity
criteria.hint: How many have the problem, how often, how much it costs them.

criteria.label: Why now
criteria.hint: A PESTEL factor that makes this more urgent today than 3 years ago.

criteria.label: Someone will pay
criteria.hint: Who pays, how much, through which revenue model.

criteria.label: Feasible to launch
criteria.hint: Could a seed-stage team launch it in the chosen market?

selection.rationale: Strongest evidence base (PortMiami's record year) and a customer we can find at one place: the cruise terminals. H-diego-01 is interesting but rests on sources we haven't found yet.
